levels.title: Present Simple

levels.title: Present Continuous
levels.description: Actions happening right now: am / is / are + verb-ing.

questions.text: He is sleeping right now.
questions.explanation: Use is + verb-ing for actions happening now.

questions.text: They is watching a film.
questions.explanation: Use are with they.

questions.text: I am studying for my exam.
questions.correctAnswer: I am studying for my exam.
questions.explanation: Use am + verb-ing with I.

questions.text: She are cooking dinner.
questions.explanation: Use is with he, she and it.

levels.title: Past Simple
levels.description: Finished actions: regular -ed verbs and irregular forms.

questions.text: We watched a movie last night.
questions.correctAnswer: We watched a movie last night.
questions.explanation: watch becomes watched in the past.

questions.text: She goed to school yesterday.
questions.explanation: Go becomes went - an irregular past form.

questions.text: He bought a new phone last week.
questions.correctAnswer: He bought a new phone last week.
questions.explanation: buy becomes bought.

questions.text: They eated all the pizza.
questions.explanation: eat becomes ate - an irregular past form.

questions.text: I saw him at the station.

questions.explanation: see becomes saw.

questions.text: She taked the bus this morning.
questions.correctAnswer: She took the bus this morning.

questions.explanation: take becomes took.

questions.text: The concert finished at ten o'clock.
questions.correctAnswer: The concert finished at ten o'clock.
questions.explanation: Regular verbs add -ed in the past.

questions.text: He catched a big fish.
questions.explanation: catch becomes caught.

levels.title: Comparatives
levels.description: Bigger, better, the best: comparing things correctly.

questions.text: This book is more interesting than that one.
questions.correctAnswer: This book is more interesting than that one.
questions.explanation: Long adjectives use more + adjective.

questions.text: He is the most fast runner in the class.
questions.correctAnswer: He is the fastest runner in the class.
questions.correction: He is the fastest runner in the class.
questions.explanation: Fast is short: use the fastest.

questions.text: She is taller than her brother.
questions.correctAnswer: She is taller than her brother.
questions.explanation: Short adjectives add -er.
